entities.summary: The Evangelical Church of the Augsburg Confession in Slovenia is a Lutheran denomination in Slovenia. It is led by Bishop Leon Novak. The church is a member of the Lutheran World Federation, which it joined in 1952, and also belongs to the Conference of European Churches and the Community of Protestant Churches in Europe.
